pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Edge angularity is high. Surface area of patches decreases significantly toward the lower-rear visible quadrant.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Intersections form clear nodes with three or four intersecting pathways. Thickness is relatively consistent, approximately 10-20% of the adjacent patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, fibrous 1D contour along the dorsal neck with a repeating low-amplitude jagged pattern against the out-of-focus background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Several small, dark, punctate textural disruptions and hyper-pigmented spots are visible on the shoulder and lower neck area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A pronounced concave structural anomaly is visible on the mid-dorsal ridge, causing a discontinuity in the otherwise smooth dorsal line.
